requests.prompt: Image 1 is the approved wooden flagship museum design. Use ONLY the dark WALNUT ARCH RIBS and brown upper wall panel material from Image 1 as the material reference. Deliver one single square seamless physically based rendering base-color texture, an orthographic close scan of this warm dark walnut wood, filling the entire canvas. Continuous vertical longitudinal grain, subtle high-frequency fibrous ridges, realistic pores, narrow irregular wavy grain lines, moderate natural variation. Match the source's brown walnut tone and satin aged finish; do not make it near-black, pale, red mahogany, or orange. The texture is flat albedo without baked shadows, without highlights, no perspective, no borders, no text, no ships or furniture. No plank seams: the geometry will supply boards. The whole image is ONLY seamless walnut material.
